label: 2.05ct D VS1 — lively smaller contender, disputed grades
commentary: The smaller Whiteflash contender attracted positive community comparisons with the larger candidate (#30–#45), particularly for its small table, octagonal outline, noticeable windmills and contrast framing the table without an overly dark centre. lovedogs, Dreamer_D and Ibrakeforpossums generally favoured the appearance; Ibrakeforpossums described liveliness as frequent flashes with little static time (#45). IMPORTANT source conflict: the Whiteflash listing identifies GIA 2135242286 as 2.05ct D VS1, while the original forum table calls it E VS1 (#43) and later posts D VS2 (#57/#61). The listed grading is source-reported rather than independently verified here; retain this discrepancy and do not establish a certified cross-catalogue link from it.
